articles.title: Talents - Help

Tiers: Minor, Medium, Legendary Medium, Core; Medium types usually need the preceding Minor.
Each Core slot activates one chosen Core Talent, swappable anytime.
Resets are free until Lv. 90, then cost Oblivion Points from Elixir of Oblivion.
unknowns: Quest bonus point total is not stated.
Node count needed to open Core Talent slots is not given.

articles.title: Twinightmare - Help
articles.summary: Sweet Dreams build reward Dream Bubbles; surviving a Nightmare makes them real.
findings: Nightmare chance rises per Sweet Dream floor until forced.
Each Nightmare death loses floor(total/6) bubbles; fractions accumulate, adding one extra loss after reaching 1; losses settle on exit.
Nightmare inherits 1 base drop buff (not Resonance, Compass, cards); level = average round map level.
Timemark 7+: Orange+ bubbles may drop Profound Dream Talking.
Each Sweet Omen brings a Nightmare Omen; omens can waste on capped targets.
unknowns: Whether 'total' is fixed at entry or shrinks between deaths is ambiguous (deductions settle at exit).
Which bubbles (quality) are randomly lost is not specified.
Nightmare chance per floor, Vision size and Profound Dream Talking rate are not given.
Which base drop buff is inherited when several exist is not stated.
An untitled card in the Twinightmare tab shows Pactspirit-style data, not Help text.
Site footer says its data comes from beta testing, not the final release; correspondence to the current client/version is not verified.

formulas.expression: lossAtDeath_k = floor(B/6) + [acc_(k-1) >= 1]; acc_k = acc_(k-1) - [acc_(k-1) >= 1] + frac(B/6); acc_0 = 0
assumptions: B = total Dream Bubbles, assumed constant because deductions settle at exit
Extra bubble is taken on the death after the remainder reaches 1, as the page orders it
Closed form of the previous recurrence; cap at B assumed
Example B=10: losses after 1..4 deaths = 1, 2, 4, 6

formulas.expression: nightmareStageLevel = mean(levels of all maps in this round)
inheritedBaseDropBuffs = 1, excluding Netherrealm Resonance, Compass and card buffs
